chunks: He replied: "Only God will bring it on you if He please, and you cannot prevail against Him."
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God brings what He wills and we cannot overpower Him?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the absolute sovereignty of Allah (SWT) in decreeing events, affirming that human efforts cannot override divine will. It highlights the concept of 'La Mukhraj' (no escape) for those who oppose God's command, reinforcing the theological principle of divine omnipotence and the inevitability of His judgment.
